description: Secretariat of the Governor - Eastern Province - Amended that the Subject of the Ministries and Cluster of Eastern Provincial Council with Effect from 01st of June 2024
reasoning: This gazette exclusively details structural and administrative changes to the Eastern Provincial Council's ministries, departments, and their assigned functions. It outlines the reallocation of subjects and responsibilities between different ministries and clusters (e.g., moving "Irrigation" from one ministry to another). While the Governor, M. Senthil Thondaman, is named as the authority issuing the notice, the content itself does not appoint him or any other individual to a new role; it solely focuses on the restructuring of government portfolios and departments, making it a pure Organisational Gazette.
